description: NZ Building Outlines Lifecycle (Deprecated) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Topographic Office. Note: This table is no longer being updated as of January 2025 This table provides the relationships between building outlines within mainland New Zealand when buildings are split or merged. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Topographic Office. Its tags are structure. It offers 1 resource(s) in table. The portal shows 2025-02-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
